entries.ec24700e137a3c34: Based on the "FY25-27 Medium-Term Management Plan," the company aims to maximize earnings from its core affiliate network business, while expanding investment in its Strategic Business, including the digital marketing support tool suite "N-INE" and the influencer marketing company WAND, Inc., with the stated goal of evolving from a provider of an advertising network into a "prosumer support company" that supports digital marketing in general on an end-to-end basis. entries.f9fc464c99fd6309: This business operates the affiliate advertising service “A8.net” and the CPI advertising service for smartphone apps “A8app”. Under this scheme, when purchases, member registrations or other results occur on an advertiser's site, rewards are paid according to those results to partner sites that serve as advertising media; the Company is responsible for calculating the results of each advertisement, collecting advertising fees from advertisers, and paying rewards to partner sites. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥5,660 million.
entries.fdfa91e152ddb86b: The breakdown of net sales is: the CPA solutions business at ¥5,660 million, accounting for about 8 tenths of the total; and the strategic business at ¥1,435 million. The company operates its business amid the continuing expansion of the internet advertising market against the background of corporate DX promotion, and the spreading use of performance-based affiliate advertising and influencer marketing.
